name: First
subtitle: Your first progressive lens experience, made simpler and more natural.
description: A progressive lens for people starting to wear multifocals. Designed for comfortable adaptation and clear, natural vision at every distance.
intro: Novar First is designed to make the transition to progressive lenses simpler, more comfortable, and more natural.
details: Its design prioritizes distance vision and provides a smooth transition to intermediate and near vision.
idealFor: People aged 40 to 45 who are beginning to experience presbyopia

technologies.name: Psicoptix Technology™
technologies.description: An exclusive Novar technology that combines advanced optics and visual neuroscience to create lenses that adapt to how you see the world. The result: more natural, comfortable, clear vision with every glance.

technologies.name: CDT Technology™
technologies.description: Continuum Design Technology helps optimize the lens surface to improve optical definition and visual fields, elevating the progressive-lens experience.

questions.question: What is Novar First?
questions.answer: It is a progressive lens for people who are starting to wear multifocals and want a comfortable adaptation.

questions.question: Who is it recommended for?
questions.answer: For people beginning to notice difficulty seeing up close who need a progressive solution for all distances.

questions.question: What makes it different?
questions.answer: Its design prioritizes an experience that is simple, natural, and easy to incorporate into daily use.
